title: ProjectUI Widget Layout
description: Data-driven widget layout consumed by the ProjectUI layout builder. Root is a single widget node; children form a tree. Every widget has a 'type' and usually a 'name'. Optional properties are permissive because builders ignore unknown keys (each widget type reads the keys it understands). Schema enforces root structure and widget 'type' enum; detailed per-type field validation is intentionally NOT enforced to avoid lockstep maintenance with ProjectUI layout builder evolution.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file

settings.description: Optional layout-level settings consumed by panel builders (e.g. cellSize for grid inventory panels).

root.description: Root widget node. Usually a CanvasPanel or Border.

type.description: Widget type resolved by the layout builder.

name.description: Widget name used for binding and lookups.
